items.exampleEn: The farmer has two big pigs.
items.exampleZh: 那位農夫養了兩頭大豬。

items.exampleEn: There is a rat in the garbage.
There are many sheep on the hill.
There is a bee on the flower.
The lion is the king of animals.
The white rabbit has long ears.
items.exampleZh: 那隻白兔有長長的耳朵。

items.sentenceEn: The lion is sleeping under the tree.

items.audioEn: At the farm, we saw pigs, sheep, and a cute rabbit.
items.audioZh: 在農場，我們看到了豬、羊，還有一隻可愛的兔子。
items.questionZh: 說話者覺得哪一種動物很可愛？

items.sentenceEn: Rats live under the old house.
items.sentenceZh: 老鼠住在那棟老房子底下。

items.stemEn: A ____ has long ears and likes to jump.
items.stemZh: 兔子有長長的耳朵，喜歡跳。

items.passageEn: Today, Jenny's class goes to the zoo. First, they see a lion. It is big, and it is sleeping. Then they see some snakes. Jenny is afraid of them. After that, they visit a small farm in the zoo. There are pigs, sheep, and rabbits. Jenny loves a little white rabbit.
items.passageZh: 今天 Jenny 的班級去動物園。他們先看到一隻獅子，牠很大，正在睡覺。接著他們看到幾條蛇，Jenny 很怕牠們。之後，他們去參觀動物園裡的小農場，那裡有豬、羊和兔子。Jenny 很喜歡其中一隻小白兔。

questions.questionZh: Jenny 很喜歡哪一種動物？

referenceEn: I am not afraid of snakes.
rubricZh: 「害怕⋯」例如 be afraid of（寫 be scared of 也正確）
「在睡覺」用現在進行式（例如 is sleeping）
「那隻獅子」可寫，例如 that lion、the lion 等
